description: Read one group chat message. Use it to see the message that a reply's `reply_to` names. One message of a group you are in. A message sent before you joined, a message of another group and an unknown one all return 404. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

name: get_group_message
title: Read one group chat message
